sql: SELECT professional_id, last_name, cell_number FROM Professionals WHERE state = 'Indiana' UNION SELECT T1.professional_id, T1.last_name, T1.cell_number FROM Professionals T1 JOIN Treatments T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id GROUP BY T1.professional_id HAVING count(*) > 2
